title: Wavex Complete Car Care Combo | Dashboard Polish 1L, Carnauba Wax 1L, Tyre Polish 1L, Graphene Ceramic Wash Kit with 20L Bucket, Grit Guard, Wash Mitt & Microfiber Drying Towel
description: Give your vehicle complete interior and exterior care with the WaveX Complete Car Detailing Kit. Designed for car enthusiasts and professional detailers alike, this comprehensive maintenance kit contains everything needed to clean, protect, shine and maintain your vehicle. The Dashboard Polish & Leather Conditioner restores and protects interior surfaces including plastic, leather, vinyl and rubber, helping preserve their original appearance. The premium Carnauba Wax Polish enhances paint gloss and depth while adding a protective finish to painted panels, headlights and chrome trims. For tyres, the advanced Tyre Polish delivers a rich, long-lasting black shine with a non-greasy, water-repellent finish. The Graphene Ceramic Wash Shampoo, combined with the included 20L wash bucket, grit guard and dual-sided wash mitt, provides a safer washing experience while helping maintain a slick, glossy finish. To complete the detailing process, the Flash Dry XL Twisted Loop Microfiber Drying Towel absorbs large amounts of water quickly, enabling fast, streak-free drying with minimal effort. Whether you are performing routine maintenance or preparing your vehicle for a special occasion, the WaveX Complete Car Detailing Kit offers a convenient all-in-one solution for achieving a clean, protected and showroom-worthy finish.
